weight_feedback.description: Multiplicative adjustments to weights, clamped by the recommendation loop to [0.5, 1.5] and enforced again here - scoring-service is deployed on its own port, so the clamp cannot rely on the caller.

id.description: Slug of the name; uniform across US and non-US schools.

unitid.description: Federal IPEDS UNITID where matched. US only.

country.description: Gates whether US federal enrichment can apply.

population.description: Student-body composition. Null for non-US schools; provenance.population reads not_applicable.

net_price_calculator_url.description: Where a student finds what they specifically would pay.

avg_sat.description: Observed only. Never derived from GPA.

net_price.description: Average annual cost after aid. Renamed from `tuition` in v2.0.0, which conflated net cost with sticker price.

sticker_tuition.description: Out-of-state tuition and fees, which is simply the price at a private school. See tuition_in_state.

tuition_in_state.description: In-state tuition and fees. US only - null and provenance not_applicable elsewhere. Identical to sticker_tuition at a private school, and less than half of it at most publics.

programs.description: Share of degrees the school actually awards, by 2-digit CIP family, largest first. Zero shares are omitted. Null means unmeasured; an empty array means measured and awarding nothing in these families - the difference is what makes 'this school does not offer X' sayable. Never derived from the editorial `majors` list, which names strengths rather than the full catalogue.

enrollment.description: Undergraduate only, to stay comparable across sources.

culture.description: Six bipolar axes, aligned with Profile.culture_prefs. Required: it drives 18% of the score.

details.description: Curated per-school profile (scholarships, research, outcomes, graduate and professional schools). Free-form because sections are heterogeneous. Null when no profile exists - never generated filler. provenance.details records the tier.

provenance.description: Per-field origin: observed | web_verified | editorial | not_applicable | absent.

scores.description: Sorted by descending score, then ascending university_id.
